violation_type.title: Types of Vehicles Used to Transport Children - Be Maintained Safely (26 TAC §746.5603(c))
violation_type.short_title: Types of Vehicles Used to Transport Children - Be Maintained Safely
violation_type.typical_finding: One vehicle was observed to have expired liability insurance required to operate a driving vehicle required by Department of motor vehicles for the state of Texas.

finding_variants.text: One vehicle was observed to have expired liability insurance required to operate a driving vehicle required by Department of motor vehicles for the state of Texas.
One transportation van was found with a deployed air bag.
Van with license plate U35-115 does not have a mirror on the ride side of the vehicle.
The childcare center transportation bus registration sticker has expired on 07/01/2022.
There was cup with left over coffee in between two infant car seats in the transportation vehicle.     Note: The coffee cup was removed from the bus.
The sound alarm system in the transporting vehicle did not work properly, it stopped the sound itself before the driver could turn the alarm off.
